reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Billing dispute tickets roughly doubled since August 2026 (F-06), and the majority of the 3025 disputed bills (1785) are built on ACTUAL meter reads rather than estimates (F-01/F-02) — ruling out slow ticket handling (F-05 shows response within SLA) as the main driver and limiting how much estimate-substitution causes can explain.
